sap_vs_psf_depth: All data, same ephemeris, same own detrend: PSF (FLUX) depth 158 +- 21 ppm vs SAP_FLUX depth 84 +- 22 ppm, ratio SAP/PSF = 0.53 +- 0.15. For a signal on the target with crowdsap = 0.91 one expects SAP/PSF close to 0.9; a ratio of 0.5 is ~2.5 sigma below that. SAP per-year depths are [25, -33, 68, 277] ppm, i.e. the SAP 'signal' lives almost entirely in year 4. After trimming 0.25 d from every data-segment edge the two agree at the noise floor (PSF 57 +- 21, SAP 43 +- 23 ppm), so the PSF/SAP mismatch is itself driven by how the two photometries respond to the segment-edge ramps, not by astrophysical dilution. No dilution inference can be drawn from this star.
disagreements: Headline interpretation: the pipeline's stage-2 v1.5 verdict is stage2_pass=true; my re-derivation finds the 32.556-d signal is 73% (116 of 158 ppm of the mean depth) supplied by three single events at epochs n=1, 12, 39 (tc 181.42, 539.53, 1418.53 BKJD; local depths 2159, 1406, 1397 ppm) that each lie 0.06-0.09 d from a data-segment edge (end of a Q2 segment before a 2.2-d gap; first cadences of Q6; first cadences after a mid-Q15 gap) where the raw flux shows a 3000-6000 ppm ramp. These are detrending edge artefacts, not transits.

With those three epochs excised (rule fixed in advance: |local depth| > 5x median |local depth| and segment-edge distance < 0.15 d) the box depth is 51 +- 21 ppm (empirical SNR 2.4) and the blind 1-50 d BLS no longer shows 32.556 d at all (SDE 0.48, rank 58359 of 190319 periods). With the principled alternative of trimming 0.25 d from every segment edge before detrending: depth 57 +- 21 ppm (SNR 2.7), odd/even 65/51 ppm (0.3 sigma), per-year [54, 37, 85, 42] ppm, BLS SDE at the pipeline period 1.4 (rank 20104); top edge-trimmed peak is 1.390 d at SDE 9.2 vs an inverted-null max of 7.2, i.e. nothing above noise.

Inverted-flux null on the full data: max SDE 10.74 at 1.4956 d, which exceeds the real top peak (SDE 10.60 at 32.556 d). By the repo's own rule the real detection is not distinguishable from the inverted null on this star.

The pipeline's own events.csv already records the same three events (n=1: 1114 ppm at gap_dist 0.13 d; n=12: 1016 ppm at 0.038 d; n=39: 988 ppm at 0.088 d) and event_chi2_const = 108.5 for 42 dof, yet v1.5 passed the star; the earlier v1.4 rules failed it on tls_sde (TLS SDE 4.0 at 32.80 d). The stage-2 single-event/gap-proximity logic did not catch segment-edge events because (as with my first gap metric) a segment start/end is not a 'gap within the window'.

Numbers that DO reproduce on the full, un-trimmed data: period 32.55555 vs 32.55706 d, t0 148.8655 vs 148.8235 BKJD (0.04 d, within a duration), duration 3.60 vs 3.375 h, depth 158 +- 21 vs 191 +- 32 ppm, empirical SNR 7.6 vs 8.2, odd/even 2.6 vs 2.6 sigma, secondary -7 vs -10 ppm. Agreement on these statistics is expected because both analyses are measuring the same three edge artefacts.

The committed results.json in commit f10bb6c ('all four survive; two candidate-grade') is the earlier version of this re-derivation without the edge-event analysis; the current results.json supersedes it and does not support survival for this star.

narrative_markdown:
## Independent re-derivation: gaia-dr3-2102601072256824704 (run poolA_main, adversarial/rederive, 2026-10-17)

**Verdict: the 32.556-d first-screen signal does not survive. It is dominated by three detrending edge artefacts, not a repeating transit.** Every number below is in `runs/poolA_main/adversarial/gaia-dr3-2102601072256824704/rederive/results.json`, produced by `rederive.py` in the same directory (own loader, own running-median detrend, astropy BoxLeastSquares on an own log-uniform grid; nothing from `pipeline/` imported or read before the numbers were produced).

### Method
- KBONUS-BKG LIGHTCURVE_STITCHED, SAP_QUALITY==0, finite, 60,346 cadences; per-quarter median normalisation; gap-aware sliding running median (1.0 d window, segments split at gaps > 0.5 d, 3 sigma-clip iterations); point-to-point rms 306 ppm.
- Blind BLS 1-50 d, 190,319 periods (phase drift < 0.03 d over the baseline), durations 0.06-0.35 d, likelihood objective; SDE = detrended power in units of its scatter. Identical inverted-flux (2-f) null on the same grid.
- Depth errors are empirical: std of box means at 2000 random phases of the same duration (red-noise aware).

### Blind search (full data)
Top 3 peaks: **32.5557 d (SDE 10.6)**, 39.7809 d (9.5), 9.5352 d (9.5). The pipeline period is recovered as the top peak (1/1). **But the inverted null peaks at SDE 10.7 (1.4956 d), higher than the real top peak**, so on this star the real search does not beat its own null.

### At the refined ephemeris (full data, own detrend)
P = 32.55555 d, t0 = 148.8655 BKJD (BJD 2454981.8655), duration 3.60 h, box depth **158 +- 21 ppm (empirical SNR 7.6)**, 43 covered events, odd/even 214/105 ppm (2.6 sigma), secondary at phase 0.5: -7 ppm (-0.4 sigma), per-year depths [235, 185, 70, 155] ppm. These reproduce the pipeline's vet.json (P 32.55706, 3.375 h, 191 +- 32 ppm, SNR 8.2, odd/even 2.6 sigma) to within errors.

### Why that reproduction is not reassuring
Per-event local depths (results.json -> psf_unmasked_detrend.events): 40 events scatter around 0-200 ppm; three events stand at **2159, 1406 and 1397 ppm** (epochs n = 1, 12, 39; tc = 181.42, 539.53, 1418.53 BKJD). Each is **0.06-0.09 d from a data-segment edge** (end of a Q2 segment before a 2.2-d gap; the first cadences of Q6 at 539.47; the first cadences after a mid-Q15 gap at 1418.46) and the raw flux there is a 3000-6000 ppm ramp into/out of the gap that a one-sided running median cannot follow (listed cadence by cadence in diagnostics.log). Together they supply **116 of the 158 ppm (73%) of the mean depth**.

- Excising those three epochs (+-1 d; rule fixed before looking: |local depth| > 5x median |local depth| and edge distance < 0.15 d): depth 51 +- 21 ppm (SNR 2.4); odd/even 63/39 (0.6 sigma); per-year [53, 38, 70, 34]; blind BLS: 32.556 d has SDE 0.48, rank 58,359.
- Principled version, trimming 0.25 d from every segment edge *before* detrending (removes 1,661 cadences): depth **57 +- 21 ppm (SNR 2.7)**, odd/even 65/51 (0.3 sigma), per-year [54, 37, 85, 42]; blind BLS SDE at the pipeline period 1.4 (rank 20,104); top edge-trimmed peak 1.390 d at SDE 9.2 against an inverted-null max of 7.2, i.e. consistent with noise.

### SAP vs PSF
Full data: SAP depth 84 +- 22 ppm vs PSF 158 +- 21 ppm, ratio 0.53 +- 0.15 (crowdsap 0.91 would predict ~0.9); SAP per-year [25, -33, 68, 277]. Edge-trimmed: SAP 43 +- 23, PSF 57 +- 21. The mismatch is a property of how each photometry responds to the segment-edge ramps, not evidence about dilution.

### Comparison with the pipeline (read after my numbers were produced)
vet.json: stage2_pass = true under rules v1.5 (failed v1.4 on tls_sde; TLS SDE 4.0 at 32.80 d). The pipeline's own events.csv lists the same three events (1114, 1016, 988 ppm at gap_dist 0.13, 0.038, 0.088 d) and event_chi2_const 108.5 / 42 dof, so the evidence was there; the gap-proximity logic evidently does not treat a segment start/end as a gap. The committed results.json (commit f10bb6c, "all four survive") is the earlier version of this re-derivation without the edge analysis and is superseded. No pixel.json exists; pixel localisation should not proceed on this star.

### Recommendation for the pipeline (post-hoc, label as such)
Add a segment-edge distance to the per-event table and either trim ~0.25 d at every edge before detrending or require that the signal survive with edge-adjacent events removed. Re-check the other batch-A survivors for the same failure mode.

Figure: `fold.png` (full-data fold, edge-trimmed fold, SAP vs PSF, odd/even, secondary, per-event depths with edge-adjacent events in red, and both BLS/inverted periodograms).
